info.name: resume-blueprint HTTP
info.description: Generated by `node qa/run.mjs --emit-collection` from qa/http/*.sh. Do not hand-edit — regenerate instead. Set {{baseUrl}} to your server (default http://127.0.0.1:8787); set {{token}} only if RESUME_BLUEPRINT_TOKEN is set on the server, since auth is off by default. {{blueprintId}} is the stored blueprint the stateful requests act on — create it with POST /blueprints first, and put the rev it returns in {{rev}}. Not represented here, because their bodies are generated at run time: 04-limits.sh: POST /render (body built at run time from $big); 04-limits.sh: PATCH /blueprints/qa-depth (body built at run time from $deep); 04-limits.sh: POST /render (body built at run time from $deeprender).
